title: Kontext / graphic hierarchy
slide_intent: Separate functional and expressive image roles so each level carries an appropriate amount of detail.
strategic_value: A hierarchy from icons to signature graphics can give DB a coherent expressive range.
demonstration: Three heart icons in 20, 24 and 32 sizes are compared with a 96-size heart signature graphic beneath the role explanation.
practical_value: Choose icons for rapid function and signature graphics for the bridge toward expression; do not assume the unfinished illustration system is supplied.

content_islands.spec: Compare the three outline hearts with the larger striped heart.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text distinguishes quick functional recognition, a bridge to expression and an emotional illustration level.
